LESSON: TRADE AND FINANCE IN ISLAM

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: General
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.3: Trade and Finance in Islam
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Trade and Finance in Islam, part of Muamalat (Social Relations) in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 General.

Key inquiry question: Why are agreements and contracts used in business transactions?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss the rules on agreements and contracts according to Islamic teachings (Q2:282) in groups and present on charts/PowerPoint,

2. research using digital devices/available reference materials on the significance of agreements and contracts and make notes,

3. dramatise the rules of agreements and contracts, learners with blindness can be given physical support as they role play,

4. discuss the importance of consumer awareness in relation to making agreements and contracts in groups and present in class.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss the rules on agreements and contracts according to Islamic teachings (Q2:282) in groups and present on charts/PowerPoint,
2. research using digital devices/available reference materials on the significance of agreements and contracts and make notes,
3. dramatise the rules of agreements and contracts, learners with blindness can be given physical support as they role play,
4. discuss the importance of consumer awareness in relation to making agreements and contracts in groups and present in class.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Trade and Finance in Islam together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
